Players Committee card image of [[Ysanne Isard]] (original printing), game text: “Power +3 while defending a battle with a spy. While with a non-frozen captive, attrition against opponent everywhere is +2. During your move phase, may use 1 Force to 'break cover' of an Undercover spy here. Immune to attrition < 3.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/ysanneisard.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
